summary: Verified PartnerApp notifications-screen top-nav fix. STATIC verification of RN code + BACKEND API verification against the preview backend. Native UI could not be exercised in a browser (Expo React Native app, no web preview), so UI check is static as instructed in the review request.

static_frontend_verification.finding_2: Line 81 renders <AppShellHeader profileRoute={user?.role === 'merchant' ? '/(merchant)/profile' : '/(partner)/profile'} /> as the FIRST child inside the root <View> (before the count row and FlatList) — so the top nav is now the first thing on the screen.
static_frontend_verification.finding_3: AppShellHeader (/app/PartnerApp/src/components/AppShell.tsx L25-149) renders a visible glass-card header with testID 'app-shell-header' and contains: brand/logo wordmark, bell Pressable testID 'partner-notifications' (unread badge), theme toggle testID 'theme-toggle', divider, and profile chip testID 'partner-profile-chip' — matches the expected top-nav described in the bug report.
static_frontend_verification.finding_4: AppShellHeader uses paddingTop=insets.top+12 so it respects the safe-area and is NOT hidden under the status bar.
static_frontend_verification.finding_5: The old <AppHeader/> in /app/PartnerApp/src/components/Screen.tsx remains gutted (insets spacer only) — but notifications.tsx no longer uses it, so the regression it caused on this screen is fixed.
static_frontend_verification.finding_6: Route re-export at /app/PartnerApp/app/(partner)/partner/notifications.tsx just re-exports the fixed component, so /partner/notifications (the route pushed by the bell at AppShell.tsx L97) renders the same header.
static_frontend_verification.verdict: FIX LOOKS CORRECT: the Notifications screen now has the AppShellHeader (brand + bell + theme-toggle + profile chip) at the top like Dashboard/Active Job/Wallet.

critical_code_review_comments: Minor: profileRoute logic in notifications.tsx uses role==='merchant' → '/(merchant)/profile' else '/(partner)/profile'. For customers (if they ever hit this shared screen) they get the partner profile route — fine because this screen is reached from the (partner) group bell. Not a bug for the reported flow.

Note: AppHeader in Screen.tsx is intentionally gutted but still exported — any OTHER screen still importing <AppHeader/> (not AppShellHeader) will have the SAME 'invisible top nav' regression. Recommend grep -rn 'AppHeader' in PartnerApp/app to find similar screens and either delete AppHeader or route it to AppShellHeader to prevent future recurrence.
